headline: OpenAI talent exodus signals stability concerns before IPO filing
body: Multiple senior researchers and engineers are departing OpenAI ahead of its anticipated IPO, with industry observers flagging organizational instability as a material risk factor. For healthcare AI deployments, leadership turnover at foundational model vendors directly impacts roadmap commitments, API stability, and long-term support for clinical integrations. Healthcare systems evaluating OpenAI partnerships for EHR automation, clinical documentation, or diagnostic support should stress-test vendor continuity clauses and clarify escalation protocols. This churn adds complexity to procurement decisions already challenged by regulatory uncertainty and the need for validated model performance in clinical workflows.
